mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'ACCEPTED', 'GOING', 'PAUSED', 'TRANSFER_PENDING', 'SUBMITTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED')
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, accepted_time))) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND accepted_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, accepted_time, submitted_time))) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND accepted_time IS NOT NULL AND submitted_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM evaluation WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND (sla_response_breached = 1 OR sla_handle_breached = 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session WHERE deleted = 0 AND resolved = 2
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) FROM ai_chat_message WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) FROM ai_chat_message WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT rc.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM work_order wo JOIN repair_category rc ON wo.category_id = rc.id WHERE wo.deleted = 0 AND rc.deleted = 0 GROUP BY wo.category_id, rc.name ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT mw.id AS workerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS workerName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, mw.avg_score AS avgScore FROM work_order wo JOIN maintenance_worker mw ON wo.accepted_worker_id = mw.id JOIN `user` u ON mw.user_id = u.id WHERE wo.deleted = 0 AND mw.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND wo.accepted_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.create_time >= #{startTime} AND wo.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY mw.id, u.real_name, u.username, mw.avg_score ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{top}
SELECT score AS score, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM evaluation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY score
